To obtain a FAM Club Licence, teams must be financially healthy and meet certain standards of conduct as organisations. As part of privation effort for the league, all clubs compete in Liga Super Malaysia and Liga Premier Malaysia will be required to obtained FAM Club Licence.{{cite web|url=http://www.fam.org.my/club-licensing-malaysia|title=Club Licensing in Malaysia – FAM|work=fam.org.my|access-date=28 March 2017|archive-date=2 April 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190402075225/http://www.fam.org.my/club-licensing-malaysia|url-status=dead}}{{cite web|url=http://footballmalaysia.com/files/Club%20Licensing.pdf|title=Why Club Licensing? – footballmalaysia|website=FootballMalaysia.com|access-date=14 January 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160330224745/http://footballmalaysia.com/files/Club%20Licensing.pdf|archive-date=30 March 2016|url-status=dead}} As in other national leagues, there are significant benefits to being in the top division: *A greater share of television broadcast licence revenues goes to Liga Super Malaysia sides. *Greater exposure through television and higher attendance levels helps Liga Super Malaysia teams attract the most lucrative sponsorships. *Liga Super Malaysia teams develop substantial financial muscle through the combination of television and gate revenues, sponsorships and marketing of their team brands. This allows them to attract and retain skilled players from domestic and international sources and to construct [[wikt:Special:Search/first class|first-class]] stadium facilities. [[Kuala Lumpur FA|Kuala Lumpur]] and [[Terengganu F.C. I|Terengganu]] promoted to 2018 Malaysia Super League after securing place as champions and runners-up in [[2017 Malaysia Premier League]]. On 21 November 2017, it was announced that T-Team who finished ninth in the Super League last year, will play in the [[2018 Malaysia Premier League]] pending approval from Football Malaysia LLP (FMLLP).{{cite web|title=T-Team to play in Premier League|url=https://www.nst.com.my/sports/football/2017/11/305719/t-team-play-premier-league|date=21 November 2017|publisher=New Straits Times}} The suggestion then were approved on 4 December 2017, followed by an announcement stating that [[Felda United F.C.|Felda United]], who finished third last season are ineligible to compete in this year top-tier competition. They were replaced by [[Negeri Sembilan FA|Negeri Sembilan]] and [[PKNP F.C.|PKNP]].{{cite web|title=Super League Reign' PKNP and NS|date=4 December 2017|url=https://www.hmetro.com.my/arena/2017/12/290434/rezeki-liga-super-pknp-dan-ns}}
